_comment: Mutation testing per ADR-020. Scoped to packages/core because that is where a surviving mutant means a wrong score for a real person. Run with `pnpm mutate`.
_pluginsComment: pnpm's isolated node_modules means Stryker cannot auto-discover its plugins; they must be named explicitly or it fails with 'no TestRunner plugins were loaded'.
_thresholdComment: RATCHET, not an aspiration. `break` sits just below the measured baseline (65.03% on 2026-08-12), so the score can never get WORSE without failing the build. Raise it as survivors are killed; NEVER lower it without a HONESTY_LOG entry saying why. Setting it to an aspirational 75 would have blocked all work behind a 607-mutant backlog, which buys nothing.
